panel_geometry.rule: Radii are small: 4px (most common), 6px, 8px, 10px; Inbox --ibx-radius 6px; tokens --site-radius-sm/md/lg/xl 4/8/16/24.
Panels: white/near-white glass (rgba(255,255,255,0.84–0.95)) with 1px light-grey line (#d8d8dc/#dedee2) and soft low shadow; red-framed variant for selected/priority item.
Corner-bracket framed tiles (L-shaped corner marks) on stat tiles in public/projects surfaces.

buttons.rule: Primary solid red; secondary red outline; ghost grey outline; 42px action buttons in Inbox priority card; CTA text uppercase with -> arrow.

inputs.rule: Search field: white, 1px grey border, magnifier left, uppercase placeholder; chips/pills rounded with red selected state; red toggle.

cards_boards.rule: Suspended boards: white glass boards with numbered heading (01 BRAND ESSENCE…), dots menu, mixed media, floating in the atrium at tilt; centre board flat and larger.
Review cards (ON YOUR TABLE): media thumbnail + title/meta + outlined red action (REVIEW > / CHOOSE > / APPROVE >).
Data tiles are sparse and instrumented (progress ring 62%, legend list with percentages) — not uniform card grids.

navigation.rule: Production bottom nav: 7 fixed tabs HUB INBOX DESIGN EXPERIENCE EXPRESSION LIBRARY ACTIVITY; 56px mobile (+safe-area), 58px desktop; 11px labels; 22–28px icons; active = red icon + 2px red underline; notification 6px red dot.
Icon position: icon ABOVE label in PARENT_3VIEW authority at all viewports; live tablet/desktop code places icon LEFT (conflict C1).
DESIGN secondary mode bar: BRAND EXPERIENCE SURFACES COMPILER ASSETS VIEWPORT, red underline on active; inline in header on desktop/tablet, row below header on mobile.
Public/design-reconstruction bottom nav: ORIGIN IDNTY LOCATIONS PROJECTS CTRL ROOM with outline icons, red active.

header_systems.rule: Production host top: [red bar + TAB TITLE / SITE 00 / STUDIO WORLD] [project thumb + PROJECT NDXBOOK v] [black-red core + red count ITEMS NEED YOU] ........ [hamburger]. 58px tablet / 62px desktop; ~31px mobile measured; red 3px bar at first cluster item.
Design-reconstruction header: crosshair logo + SITE 00, bell + kebab square buttons, breadcrumb PROJECTS > SITE 00 > DESIGN, project selector chip.

footer_systems.rule: No marketing footer in workspace; the bottom nav is the footer. Public shell uses a 36px bottom status panel (--site00-bottom-panel-height).

project_selectors.rule: Project selector = square project thumbnail + micro "PROJECT" label + bold project name + chevron, inside host top bar; project personality enters only through the thumbnail and hero media.

iconography.rule: Thin line icons (stroke 1.5–1.75), monochrome ink, red when active; 24 viewBox for staged line families.

Icon dirs: design-pack/icons (nav-*, object-*), design-pack/stages (rendered 3D pipeline objects), bottom-nav/masters, icons/ndx/v3, shared/site00-studio-world-ui/icons/p0ui3a-e, src/site00/icons/mobile-nav, ai-consoles/staged (136), project-tabs/staged (113 svg + 8 raster), page-concept-generator/staged, assets/evolve.
Pipeline stage markers are rendered 3D objects (chrome sphere, black monolith, red crystal, cube system, orbital) not flat icons.

borders.rule: 1px hairlines in light grey (#d8d8dc, rgba(18,18,20,0.09–0.16)); red border only for selected/priority.

dividers.rule: Vertical 1px dividers between top cluster items and between bottom-nav items; horizontal row dividers in lists (Activity log).

type_hierarchy.rule: ALL visible text uppercase (brand uppercase law); only password fields exempt.

Hero: PROJECT micro-label (red bar left) -> very large condensed project name (NDXBOOK) -> sub-title (ENTRY 002 / EXPERIENCE) -> two-line tagline; right side ambient stacked words (IDEAS / PEOPLE / WORLDS / IN MOTION) with short red rule.
Section heads: 15px condensed caps with 3px red vertical bar, VIEW ALL -> at right.
Counts as large red numerals with small caps label (03 ITEMS NEED YOU, 01 BLOCKERS; inbox 44px red numerals).
Inbox scale tokens: title 17px, text 12px, small 10px; Host chrome uses explicit px per viewport class, never clamp/vw/zoom.

typography.rule: SITE 00 host typography (public site, design reconstruction, client app, tokens): Martian Mono via Google Fonts (wdth 75–112.5, wght 100–800), default width 87.5 semi-condensed; weights label 600, heading 700, display 800, numeric 650.
Production workspace host (pxh/pxa/pw/ibx/a-): Saira Semi Condensed self-hosted woff2 300–700, Martian Mono only as fallback.
Character Fabrication: "SITE00 Fab Condensed"/Barlow Condensed (declared specialization).
Martian Mono is host-only; never client brand canon (HOST_UI cannot become CLIENT_BRAND). JURNL uses Barlow Semi Condensed + Instrument Serif; NDXBOOK uses its own editorial faces.
Tracking restrained (display 0, label 0.06em, nav 0.04em); Production chrome letter-spacing 0.04em.

red_accent_behavior.rule: Red is a signal color only: active tab underline (2px), active nav icon, 3px vertical bar before section/project titles, counts, primary CTA fill, priority frame, notification dot (6px). Never a background field on host chrome.
Red illumination in environments: light rings, floor circles, vertical light shafts, red-lit floor grids converging on the core.
Buttons: primary = solid red w/ white text + arrow; secondary = white w/ red outline + red text; ghost = white grey outline.

motion.rule: framer-motion ^11.18.2 is a dependency but has zero imports in src/shared (unused). Motion is CSS: tokens 150/280/450ms, ease cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); most transitions 0.15s–0.2s, 180ms, 360ms; ~30 @keyframes; prefers-reduced-motion zeroes tokens (36 media blocks).

canonical_components.component: Site00ClientAppShell (header: project name + diamond marker + bell + menu; bottom nav)
Founder design-pack sheets (panel shells, drawers, buttons, tabs, review cards, pipeline tiles, device frames)

review_decision_controls_note: Approve / revision controls must carry text labels (APPROVE / NEEDS REVISION); symbols are support only. Defined in the client-room sprint.
